sourceDigest.algorithm: sha256 over sorted (path, NUL, content, NUL) for every file under src/ plus package.json, package-lock.json, .node-version

scopeNotes: Scaled-down limits (maxHistories 16, live maxConcurrentTurns 16, maxIdentities 40); no claim at default limits.
The queue-backed service workload reports the default maxConcurrentTurns 8; the live runtime workload uses 16.
Event-stream changes in the working tree are present in the measured source, but the gate does not stress stream counts, backpressure, request bodies or connections.
Heap figures are supporting evidence; the verdict comes from registry assertions. No whole-process memory bound is implied.

Earlier artifacts are unchanged. Known limitations of earlier evidence: sustained-memory-soak-2026-10-01.json used heapPlateauTolerance 0.1, not 0.05; admission-retention-2026-10-01.json ran on Node v24.15.0, the runtime with the reproduced native crash.
